version_policy.B0: Exact RTXPT1.9 source and original scenes
version_policy.B2: ReSTIR PT renderer integration; not promoted
version_policy.B3: PT++ activations and missing paper mechanisms; in progress

milestones.acceptance: PT resources, bindings, initial/temporal/spatial/final dispatch, history/reset handling and latest ABI build pass
milestones.evidence: Corrected static opaque B2 build de9fe651 executes initial/temporal/spatial/final passes; broader material/reset/reconstruction validation remains pending.

milestones.acceptance: Native material/BSDF/lighting/replay contracts compile and pass numerical and GPU checks
milestones.evidence: Corrected opaque bridge and actual-lobe reconnection verified with raw HDR and reservoir census; original transmission and binding diffuse transport remain outside prototype gates.

milestones.acceptance: Direct/indirect, native/PT, delta/non-delta and fallback contributions counted exactly once
milestones.evidence: Static opaque direct cap1 and indirect cap3 mean-lighting checks passed after light-list, MIS ownership and raw-merge repairs. Broader materials, dynamic scenes and interactive approximation controls remain unvalidated.

milestones.acceptance: Primary native medium metadata, replay, false-hit handling, eta and Beer attenuation correct for eligible transport
milestones.evidence: 48-byte primary state export foundation added; transmission still rejected by explicit prototype scene gate.

milestones.acceptance: Supported bounce-domain settings declared and validated; binding native lobe-dependent caps require exact accounting
milestones.evidence: Prototype requires a nonbinding diffuse cap. Inactive RGB survival-polynomial helper has independent finite-domain tests; not runtime integration.

milestones.acceptance: Raw/reference, replay/history, materials and reconstruction checks under matched contracts
milestones.evidence: Matched static opaque checks, active mid-path reconnection census, primary ownership MIS and fixed-neighbor ablations completed. Eight-seed DI+PT initial/reuse mean drift−0.356%/−0.350%; median HDR-FLIP0.1680/0.1034. Wider materials/motion/reconstruction remain pending.

milestones.acceptance: App, driver and active external limiter controls disabled, read back and restored for tests
milestones.evidence: Three timing processes verified effective app caps, driver caps0/VSync forced off, RTSS installed application profile0 at launch/start/end, SyncInterval0 and restoration. Other external limiters remain unknown; historical B1 coverage remains unverified.

milestones.acceptance: B0/B1/B2 matched transport, scene, cap audit and process repetitions with quality and timing evidence
milestones.evidence: Fresh three-process native B0/B1 versus strict B2 DI+PT comparison completed with display quality; B2-only raw HDR. Median GPUBusy0.803/0.806/1.519ms. One scene, different sampling estimators, no equal-quality speedup claim.

milestones.acceptance: Supported scope, checks and immutable source identity complete before assigning release tag
milestones.evidence: Pending: current mean-luminance acceptance fails; no B2 release tag. Seeded GPU diagnostics, raw-merge repair and direct-light isolation are in progress.

milestones.acceptance: Paper feature matrix, activations, missing mechanisms and isolated ablations implemented and validated
milestones.evidence: Planned after B2; inherited RTXDI3.1 mechanisms are not counted as new B3 work.

transitions.reason: User resumed integration and explicitly separated B2 ReSTIR PT from B3 PT++. Current release gate remains pending.
Matched pixel-center seeded references expose systematic brightness mismatch; direct-only probe isolates a pre-PT-indirect component. B2 promotion remains pending.
Isolated phantom environment index underflow; registered actual/synthetic environment records and corrected absolute/local light domains and PT light-vertex budget. Validation remains active.
Corrected ownership, light-list/budget/validity and actual-lobe reconnection contracts; static quality and cap-verified timing now measured. Full B2 promotion gates remain pending.
User requested B3. B2 checkpoint de9fe651 and its evidence preserved; original Convergence/Kitchen14/2 unsupported coverage now explicit.

limits: Source presence, synthetic tests and successful shader compilation do not establish renderer correctness.
Prototype gates are deliberate and do not imply original transmissive scenes are supported.
Historical B1 results remain measured exploratory evidence, with external cap coverage unverified.
